create_split_imagenet_stream: create a SplitImagenetStream instance to iterate over 100 ten-way ImageNet classification tasks
iterate_stream_events: iterate over training and prediction events from a SplitImagenetStream using the events method
get_dataset_by_key: get a specific dataset from the stream by its DatasetKey using get_dataset_by_key
build_dataset_lookup: build a parallel lookup of dataset splits for all 100 tasks using ThreadPoolExecutor
shuffle_task_order: create a SplitImagenetStream with shuffled task order by setting shuffle_tasks_order to True
